name: retrieval_anchored_trajectory_relevance
data: existing hard-confirmatory OFF exact-wire search trajectories
algorithm: extract structured identifier candidates only from the current rg/grep search pattern, not from search scope paths
exclude identifiers already present in the latest user message
require an anchor identifier to already occur in a prior tool output
for each adopted anchor, retain only its most recent prior tool output
run the frozen V3 candidate ranking and current-target conditioning over the union of those anchored prior outputs
if no adopted anchor exists, abstain and fall back to current-query-only relevance
primary_mechanism_metrics: search units with adopted structured anchors
V4 identifiers newly exposed after local reranking
incremental identifiers beyond the current search pattern
limits: this is post-hoc exploratory analysis on already observed trajectories
bridge-count reduction alone is not evidence of better task performance
no end-to-end claim is made until a later unseen prospective evaluation
